Respondents  ***
 This Miscellaneous First Appeal is filed under Section  173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, praying to allow this  -2-  MFA No. 1524 of 2022 appeal and set aside the judgment and award passed by the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC and MACT, Gundlupet, in M.V.C.No.195/2018 dated 10.02.2020 and to enhance the compensation as this Court deems fit and proper in the circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice and equity.

This Miscellaneous First Appeal coming on for orders through Physical Hearing/Video Conferencing, this day, the Court made the following:
 ORDER
Called again in the afternoon.
Learned counsel for the appellant neither physically present nor through video conference.
No reasons are forthcoming for his non-appearance in the matter.

This matter was passed over this morning to enable the learned counsel for the appellant to furnish the process fee, cover, acknowledgement copies, etc for issuance of notice to respondents No.1 and 2.
It was also made clear to the learned counsel that, in case if the needful is not done, the Court may proceed to pass appropriate order.
In spite of the same, the learned counsel for the appellant has remained absent.
Hence, the appeal stands dismissed for not taking steps in respect of respondents No.1 and 2 as well as for non-prosecution.

Sd/-
JUDGE BMV*
